title: Anthropic's acquisition spree #anthropic #staleness #openai
description:
Anthropic acquired Staleness on May 18 in a move framed as a routine deal but positioned as a strategic strike in the AI infrastructure race. Staleness was reportedly used to help OpenAI maintain and update SDK documentation across multiple programming languages through automation.

The acquisition matters because developer tooling is a critical layer of the model ecosystem. If one company controls the systems that keep APIs, SDKs, and documentation synchronized, it can influence developer experience, platform reliability, and the speed at which rivals ship updates.

The deal also fits a broader pattern: Staleness was described as Anthropic’s fourth acquisition in six months, following Bun, Wursap, and Coefficient. The larger implication is that competition between AI labs is expanding beyond model quality into the underlying tools, workflows, and infrastructure that support adoption.
